description: The ONE modeling operation engine (decision MODELING-UNIFIED-OPERATION-ENGINE) shared by the editor and the modeling_apply_operations MCP tool: Apply runs a typed batch, ApplyJson parses the byte-compatible JSON array, and Clone provides the deep copy atomic callers apply to and swap on success. It mutates the passed model in place, never touches a provider or writer, never cascades a removal (the editor expands the cascade), and matches MCP byte-for-byte for the 2.10.0 operations.
